Sr. Data Analyst - Retail Bank
At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.
In the Consumer Bank, we’ve combined this human-centered approach with our heritage of data-driven decision making to design, build and test our way to truly enabling financial experiences. We’ve challenged ourselves to spend less time planning, more time doing, and, above all else, to see the world through the eyes of our customers as they work to understand and manage their money. Retail Bank line of business and functional areas include digital/online banking, branch/cafe experience, bank operations (i.e., account maintenance, deposits, ATM, tax reporting, etc.), contact center, enterprise payments (debit, ACH, check, wires, etc.), marketing and product strategy, and small business banking (i.e., strategy and deposits, sales and servicing, and lending).
As a Data Analyst at Capital One you will leverage analytic and technical skills to innovate, build, and maintain well-managed data solutions and capabilities to tackle business problems.
On any given day you will be challenged by three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:
Innovation
+ Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms
+ Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers
+ Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives
Business Intelligence
+ Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization
+ Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies
Data Management
+ Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
+ Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
+ Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality
Our ideal candidate will have:
+ Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
+ Scripting experience in (Python, R, Spark, and SQL)
+ Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)
+ Experience utilizing and developing within Snowflake services
Basic Qualifications
+ Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 2 years of experience performing data analytics, or currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Master’s Degree with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.
+ At least 1 year of experience working with at least one scripting language
+ At least 1 year of experience utilizing business intelligence visualization tool
+ At least 1 year of experience querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms
Preferred Qualifications:
+ Master’s Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
+ At least 2 years of experience coding in Python, R, Spark, or SQL
+ At least 2 years of experience working within process management and improvement methodologies – Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, etc.
+ At least 1 year of experience utilizing and developing within AWS services
+ At least 1 year of experience working with and demonstrating knowledge of data governance, data quality management concepts and data quality tools (i.e. Informatica DQ)

Trilogy Federal drives innovative solutions for complex business challenges across financial management, healthcare, and government industries. Our collaborative, client-first service approach, combined with our commitment to the rapid implementation of pragmatic solutions, has earned Trilogy an unparalleled reputation for delivering transformative results.

Trilogy Federal seeks an experienced Data Analyst specializing in Financial Operations (FinOps) to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Summit Advanced Tooling, Lakehouse, and Artificial Intelligence Services (Summit ATLAS) program. The Data Analyst (FinOps) will analyze cloud consumption, operating costs, and resource utilization to help VA stakeholders understand expenditures, identify optimization opportunities, and make informed decisions about platform investments.

This position will support financial transparency and cost accountability across the Summit Data Platform by developing cost analyses, forecasts, dashboards, and recommendations that improve resource efficiency while maintaining operational performance and service quality.

Please note, this position is contingent upon award (anticipated early 2027) . This role will also require 1-2 domestic business trips per year.

Primary Responsibilities:
Analyze Microsoft Azure cloud consumption, spending patterns, and resource utilization across Summit platform services, applications, and customer workloads.

Develop and maintain financial dashboards, cost reports, and performance indicators that provide visibility into cloud expenditures, usage trends, and cost drivers.

Monitor cloud budgets, spending thresholds, and consumption trends to identify potential overruns, anomalies, and emerging financial risks.

Develop cost forecasts and budget projections using historical consumption, workload trends, and anticipated platform demand.

Identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary cloud spending through resource rightsizing, workload scheduling, storage optimization, and other cost management practices.

Collaborate with cloud engineers, platform administrators, and technical teams to evaluate the financial and operational impact of proposed optimization measures.

Analyze resource tagging, cost allocation, and consumption data to support accurate attribution of cloud expenses to services, environments, and customer workloads.

Support implementation of Government-approved FinOps practices, including cost accountability, financial transparency, and continuous optimization.

Evaluate the cost implications of new platform capabilities, infrastructure changes, and customer onboarding activities.

Investigate unexpected spending increases and usage anomalies, documenting root causes and recommended corrective actions.

Develop and maintain financial analysis models, reporting procedures, and supporting documentation to ensure consistent and repeatable cost assessments.

Prepare cost analysis summaries, financial performance reports, and recommendations for VA stakeholders to support resource planning and management decisions.

Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Finance , Accounting, Business Analytics, Information Technology, Data Analytics, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

Four or more years of professional experience in financial analysis, cloud cost management, business analytics, or a related discipline.

Experience analyzing cloud infrastructure costs, technology expenditures, or enterprise information technology resource consumption.

Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Power BI or comparable analytical and reporting tools.

Experience developing financial dashboards, cost models, forecasts, and variance analyses.

Proficiency in Structured Query Language (SQL) or comparable data querying and analysis techniques.

Familiarity with Microsoft Azure Cost Management, cloud billing structures, and resource consumption reporting.

Experience analyzing operational metrics, identifying spending trends, and developing actionable cost optimization recommendations.

Ability to translate technical consumption data into clear financial findings for business and technical stakeholders.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills.

Ability to meet VA personnel vetting, background investigation, and system access requirements.

The ability to travel for 1-2 domestic business trips per year .

Preferred Qualifications:
Experience supporting VA or other federal agency cloud financial management or modernization initiatives.

Hands-on experience using Microsoft Azure Cost Management, Azure Advisor, or comparable cloud cost optimization tools.

Experience implementing cloud resource tagging strategies, cost allocation models, or showback and chargeback reporting.

Knowledge of FinOps Foundation principles and practices, including cloud financial accountability and unit cost analysis.

Experience analyzing costs associated with Azure Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics, or other cloud-based data processing platforms.

Experience evaluating cloud pricing models, reserved capacity, savings plans, and workload optimization strategies.

Experience supporting cloud budget planning, financial governance, and executive-level cost reporting in large enterprise environments.

FinOps Certified Practitioner or comparable cloud financial management certification.

Benefits (including but not limited to):
Health, dental, and vision plans

Optional FSA

Paid parental leave

Safe Harbor 401(k) with employer contributions 100% vested from day 1

Paid time off and 11 paid holidays

No cost group term life/AD&D plan, and optional supplemental coverage

Pet insurance

Monthly phone and internet stipend

Tuition and training reimbursement

Overview
The Data Engineer/Analyst collaborates with clients, data scientists, and software engineers to develop and optimize data pipelines, ETL processes, and database structures that support IRS compliance activities. The role involves identifying and integrating data sources, enhancing data quality and accessibility, and creating scalable solutions to extract insights on payment collections and taxpayer behaviors. This position ensures that analytical models and data solutions are validated and prepared for deployment within agency functions.
This position aligns with Cayuse’s core values of Innovation, Excellence, Collaboration, Adaptability, and Integrity by fostering technical solutions that meet customer needs, promoting teamwork, and prioritizing quality in deliverables.
Responsibilities
+ Meets with Government clients to understand business needs, define data engineering and analysis objectives, identify data sources, and develop robust data integration and processing workflows.
+ Design and implement data pipelines, ETL processes, and database structures to automate and scale data analysis solutions for client needs.
+ Perform data cleaning, transformation, and exploratory analysis to ensure data integrity and readiness for reporting and machine learning applications.
+ Work with teams of data scientists and software engineers to build scalable, reliable data pipelines to enable machine learning models and business intelligence applications.
+ Develop and maintain models and views for seamless data access, visualization, and analysis.
+ Optimize data storage, indexing, and query performance to support efficient decision making, and present findings and solutions to clients.

+ 2–5 years of experience in data engineering, database management, and analytical. methodologies, including designing and optimizing data pipelines and ETL processes.
+ Demonstrable experience designing and implementing data processing solutions with relational or unstructured data to facilitate analytical applications.
+ Experience with structured databases and query languages (e.g., PL/SQL, Postgres, MySQL), including optimization of SQL queries.
+ Demonstrable experience with distributed data processing frameworks such as Spark or Hadoop preferred.
+ Familiarity with statistical programming languages such as SAS, R, or Stata is helpful, but not required.
+ Experience with at least one object-oriented programming language (e.g., Python, Java, Scala).

+ Must be able to pass a background check. May require additional background checks as required by projects and/or clients at any time during employment.

+ Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
+ Able to synthesize information from client and team needs into concrete, actionable work products and/or analytical plans.
+ Strong client and team interaction skills.
+ Critical thinker with excellent attention to detail.

Sr. Manager, Data Analyst - Enterprise Data Risk
At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.
As a Senior Manager, you will leverage your analytical skills and partner cross-functionally with teams throughout the company (senior business and compliance leaders, Technology, Product, Risk office, Legal, and Risk Management) to create and implement innovative solutions to identify and mitigate potential Compliance risks to the company, driving current and future Compliance Testing strategy.
With a network of hundreds of Data Analysts, Quants, and Data Scientists, challenging projects with an eye on the bottom line and a focus on work/life balance, we’ve created a dynamic environment with plenty of room for you to learn, grow, and realize your full potential.
On a given day you will be:
+ Drive current and future Compliance Testing tooling and analytical strategy
+ Planning and executing Compliance Testing analytical projects
+ Act as the primary liaison between highly technical teams (Engineers, Data Scientists, Analysts) and non-technical stakeholders (Legal, Compliance, Executive Board).
+ Understanding technical issues in analytical tools and assessing tools risks and opportunities
+ Independently researching, identifying, and prototyping industry best practices for emerging analytical tools
+ Communicating results clearly and concisely both verbally and through written communications via reports and presentations
+ Leveraging education, colleagues and training opportunities to develop solutions to business problems
+ Coaching and mentoring junior staff
An ideal candidate will possess strong problem solving and conceptual thinking abilities in addition to communication, interpersonal and leadership skills. This position will be in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment where you will be handling multiple concurrent projects while working independently and in teams.
Basic Qualifications:
+ Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 7 years of experience performing data analytics, or currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Master’s Degree plus at least 5 years of experience performing data analytics with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.
+ At least 5 years of experience performing professional data analysis work
+ At least 5 years of experience leading and developing with open source data technologies
+ At least 2 years of experience managing people
Preferred Qualifications:
+ Master’s Degree or PhD in a Finance, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, or a related field
+ At least 7 years of experience in statistical or econometrics hands-on work
+ At least 5 years of experience manipulating and performing analysis with large data sets
+ At least 5 years of experience in financial services industry
+ At least 5 years of experience in developing statistical or econometric models
+ At least 5 years of experience in validating statistical or econometric models
+ At least 2 years of experience with data governance
+ At least 2 years of experience with predictive analytics
